summary:
Senior Oracle ERP consultant and Fusion Cloud specialist with over 15+ years of
experience
in enterprise transformations across finance, HCM, and supply chain.
Expertise in architecting scalable Oracle ecosystems through integration of Fusion
applications, OIC, and automation frameworks. Proven ability in financials, HCM
data migration, SCM, and high-performance PL/SQL solutions. Skilled in bridging
Oracle EBS and Fusion environments to facilitate seamless cloud transitions and
develop secure, business-aligned ERP platforms that enhance operational agility
and decision-making.

bullets: Assisted in tuning performance of BI reports.
Participated in REST API development tasks.
Supported automation efforts through Oracle Agent AI Studio.
Aided in debugging OIC integrations and providing production support.
Guided team members through mentorship initiatives.
Scheduled weekly team calls to offer mentorship and support.
Contributed to automation and integration of Oracle Fusion modules with various applications.
Facilitated app-driven orchestration integrations, including ERP Cloud Adapter and ATP Adapter.
Executed CRUD operations and transactions in Oracle Fusion.
Created Fusion BIP reports and integrated them into ICS using stage file activity.
Monitored integration using OIC features to ensure smooth operations.
Developed ad-hoc reports as required.
Led client requirement workshops and translated functional specifications into technical design for Oracle Fusion HCM data migration and integrations.
Managed end-to-end data migration using HDL, covering workforce, salary structures, compensation components, personal demographics, and statutory data.
Designed optimized HCM Extract templates for payroll processing and third- party integrations.
Delivered bi-directional integration between Oracle EBS R12 and Oracle Fusion HCM for compensation and personal data synchronization.
Ensured data validation, reconciliation, and post-load verification with zero critical defects during go-live.
Acted as primary technical point of contact, providing daily progress tracking and stakeholder reporting.
Facilitated production support for Oracle EBS Financials (AP AR GL) to maintain over 99% system availability.
Assisted with month-end and quarter-end close processes by identifying and resolving issues proactively.
Prepared and evaluated MD200 technical documentation to align with business and architectural standards.
Assisted in financial system stabilisation activities during and after go-live to ensure smooth transition with minimal production disruptions.
Supported integration backfeed processes for ap/ar/gl to maintain financial data integrity across upstream and downstream systems.
Executed gl period setups and calendar configurations for future financial planning cycles.
Spearheaded supplier lifecycle implementation and banking configuration, ensuring accurate financial transactions and seamless P2P integration.
Established strong system governance through AOL and SysAdmin controls, enhancing security, audit readiness, and operational transparency.
Drove successful data conversion initiatives through structured reporting and reconciliation frameworks.
Partnered with functional and finance stakeholders to align technical solutions with business compliance requirements.
Facilitated PL/SQL solution design and code governance practices.
Supported performance optimisation initiatives through collaborative efforts.
Assisted teams with deployment of custom components via thorough testing and review processes.
